outcome: Give dealer operations director / fleet manager a governed method to improve affected VINs contacted within deadline using VIN master, recall notices and registration records, with final decisions…
overview: Vehicle Recall Population Matching addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in automotive and mobility operations. The first proof of value uses VIN master, recall notices and registration records. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is affected VINs contacted within deadline, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: VIN master, recall notices and registration records; define affected VINs contacted within deadline and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Dealer Operations Director / Fleet Manager.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
